challenges.name: fix-webhook-json-parsing
challenges.title: Fix the supplier webhook that trusts its JSON
challenges.description: Farms post stock deliveries to Chợ Sớm as JSON. The old code cast the parsed body with as StockUpdate, so when one farm started sending "qty": "12" the stock of eggs became the string "4812", and a renamed field created stock for the sku undefined. JSON.parse now returns unknown and the starter does not compile. Fix parseUpdate by checking the data step by step - valid JSON, an object, a non-empty sku, an integer qty, a known warehouse - and return the first reason a body is rejected, without as or any. The test runner reads one body per line, applies the accepted updates and prints the rejections and the stock per warehouse.
